request: Pull the last 30 days of NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center alerts (K-index warnings, solar flare notifications, geomagnetic storm alerts, radio blackout warnings). Include product_id, issue_datetime, and message. Enrich with alert_class (Warning/Watch/Alert/Summary), space_weather_scale (G/S/R prefix from product_id), and days_since_issued. Publish to 'Prep Agent / 18 - NOAA Space Weather Alerts' on Tableau Server for space-domain-awareness + SATCOM continuity analysts.

sources.name: NOAA SWPC Alerts
sources.description: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center alerts feed. `/products/alerts.json` returns a flat list of the last ~30 days of space-weather notifications. Each item: {product_id (e.g. K04W, ALTK07, WARK05, SUMS06 — 4-letter code where prefix indicates alert family: WAR=Warning, ALT=Alert, WAT=Watch, SUM=Summary; K=K-index geomagnetic, S=solar radiation, R=radio blackout, G=geomagnetic storm), issue_datetime (ISO), message (multi-line human-readable body with the actual data)}. Public, no auth, refreshes on-issue.

args.name: SWPC Trend
args.features_description: Adds row-level calendar features parsed from issue_datetime (year, month, quarter, day_of_week, iso_week). Row-level space-weather alert.
args.stats_description: Long-form space-weather statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over alert product family). Includes daily_count, 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies vs baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Use to spot solar-flare or geomagnetic-storm alert clusters.

outputs.name: SWPC Alerts Detail
outputs.description: Row-level NOAA SWPC alerts (trailing 30 days). Includes product_id (4-letter code: WAR=Warning, ALT=Alert, WAT=Watch, SUM=Summary + K/S/R/G family), issue_datetime, message (multi-line body), days_since_issued. Plus calendar features. Source: services.swpc.noaa.gov/products/alerts.json. Refresh: hourly.

outputs.name: SWPC Alerts Stats
outputs.description: Long-form space-weather trend statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over alert product family). Includes 7-day rolling counts, z-score anomalies, lifetime rank/pct_of_total. Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month). Use to identify space-weather event clusters affecting SATCOM/GPS/HF-radio continuity.
